candidates.prediction: A chain-rule-correct JSpace-inspired psi retains the favorable no-ladder signal on fresh cleanroom states without dense K^2p memory and with an honest target cost below 80B.

candidates.bias_class: Conditionally unbiased per-network multifidelity control variate with all pilot, fitting, teacher, and feature costs included.
candidates.kill_condition: Residual variance-per-total-cost fails to beat no student, captured content is only design-annihilated degree<=5, coefficient/direction selection uses outcomes, cross-fit bias appears, symmetry fails, or production cost is unsafe.
candidates.mechanism: Distill each disclosed deep teacher into a small analytically integrable control student from a frozen pilot, then estimate the coupled teacher-minus-student residual on independent or cross-fitted samples.
candidates.prediction: A weight/Jacobian-derived shallow-ReLU or Fourier/Gegenbauer student reduces the degree>=6 directional residual enough to improve equal-total-cost variance materially on fresh cleanroom networks.
candidates.result: The frozen students passed exact-mean, cross-fit, design-moment, symmetry, and cost-accounting tests but failed the residual objective. The layer-one ReLU student reduced pointwise variance to 0.656x while worsening the design-surviving variance to 1.145x and cost-adjusted variance to 1.981x. The degree-{6,8} Gegenbauer student scored 91.141x raw and 174.995x cost-adjusted with 0/16 wins and control-error correlation -0.0367. Kill these student dictionaries; preserve exact-mean/cross-fit/MUB/cost machinery and replace generic harmonics with predeclared Jacobian-response atoms.

candidates.bias_class: Cleanroom-frozen terminal input-sensitivity diagnostic; no transformer, vocabulary, layer-band, or official-truth dependence.
candidates.kill_condition: Hutchinson estimates fail dense-Jacobian accuracy; signed and energy lenses lack held-out stability; signed/nonnegative pursuit is non-identifiable or symmetry-breaking; the response student fails cost-adjusted residual variance; or any depth/dictionary choice uses official outcomes.
candidates.mechanism: Adapt JSpace's Hutchinson VJP identity at the terminal input-to-output map, compare the signed average E[D_0] with the energy lens G_0=E[D_0^T D_0], and use only the screened input directions in a separately gated error-link test.
candidates.prediction: The energy lens resists gate-tumbling cancellation and supplies exact-mean control directions that beat failed generic degree-{6,8} directions at equal total cost.
candidates.result: The terminal energy-lens premise survives while signed pursuit is killed. Across 12 fresh d16/L8 networks, E[D_0] retains median 0.102787 of Jacobian energy, whereas G_0 has median effective rank 5.587 and top-eight energy 0.930047. K4 has exploratory median Gram error 0.08566 and top-eight overlap 0.99574 for 2.813B input-only arithmetic. Independent audit proves the identities but finds no layerwise implementation, incomplete hidden-gauge claims, and non-identifiable repeated-atom pursuit; K4 must be re-predeclared. Preserve G_0 only as a screened diagnostic and require a fresh design-residualized error-link test.

candidates.bias_class: Conditionally unbiased response-aligned multifidelity control with pilot, teacher, feature, and residual costs charged.
candidates.kill_condition: No cost-adjusted improvement over no control; no material advantage over isotropic or signed-mean-J directions; active-subspace (rank/d)^6 suppression dominates; cross-fit bias, symmetry, or exact-mean failure; or target cost becomes unsafe.
candidates.mechanism: Use an independent K=4 fused-VJP pilot to obtain top directions of E[J^T J], construct predeclared exact-mean degree>=6 control atoms along those directions, and cross-fit coefficients before scoring only the 5-design-surviving residual.
candidates.prediction: The JSpace energy directions outperform isotropic, signed-mean-J, and no-control baselines in design-surviving variance per total cost, thereby connecting the strong workspace geometry to the actual estimand.
candidates.result: The exactly-once fresh factorial terminates the estimator link. Gram directions score 4.75763x raw and 21.0923x cost-adjusted variance with 0/16 wins and median control/error correlation 0.05057. Signed-J is 9.1184x raw; isotropic is 4.28796x. Centering fixes constant leakage and median condition is only 8.25, so failure is observability, not numerical fit: terminal local sensitivity is nearly orthogonal to the even degree>=6 design residual. Preserve G0 only as an offline PSD diagnostic and terminate the JSpace control family.

candidates.bias_class: Conditionally unbiased low-sensitivity/complement-subspace control; sign inversion is excluded as span-equivalent.
candidates.kill_condition: Bottom/complement fails no-control or isotropic, correlation remains negligible, any subspace is outcome-selected, or structural/cost gates fail. A failure terminates the JSpace estimator family.
candidates.mechanism: Invert only the failed JSpace subspace choice by testing bottom-G0 and top-G0-orthogonal-complement directions, while retaining the exact-mean cross-fit degree-{6,8} control and fresh-seed cost ledger.
candidates.prediction: If design-surviving high-degree error avoids high local-sensitivity modes, bottom or complement directions beat top-G0, isotropic, and no-control variance per total cost on fresh networks.
candidates.result: The exactly-once structural inversion is real but nonviable. Bottom-G0 and top-orthogonal controls improve raw variance 29.87% and 24.64% versus top-G0, yet score 4.24614x and 4.56290x raw, 18.8247x and 20.2474x cost-adjusted, 0/16 wins, and correlations -0.0058/0.0229. Isotropic also loses at 3.17895x. Sign negation is pointwise identical for even degrees and complement defect is 2.87e-15. Terminate the JSpace estimator/control family; preserve G0 only as an offline diagnostic.

candidates.bias_class: Potential sampler-plus-analytic control constrained by exact collapse, approximate-mean, mediant, and cost laws.
candidates.kill_condition: No coupled per-sample exact-mean surrogate exists, residual estimator collapses to pure sampling, paired residual variance per total cost fails the sampler, or official outcome is used for fitting. For matched units use R2>1-alpha_A/(R alpha_H); do not treat the one-row 0.989596 value as a population theorem.
candidates.mechanism: Invert the failed direct analytic replacement only through a genuinely coupled residual observable; reject the algebraically identical form a+mean(f-a)=mean(f) and use 0.989596 only as the conservative same-multiplier severity threshold from the one-row 96.1178x miss.
candidates.prediction: A new per-sample surrogate with exact mean and design-residual correlation can repay the 96.1178x development miss; a constant closure correction cannot.
candidates.result: The proposed constant-anchor residual collapses pathwise: a+mean(f-a)=mean(f), so it is the deployed sampler plus wasted work. A genuine control needs nonconstant g(X), an independently known exact E[g], and equal-compute ratio kappa(1-rho^2). Conditional same-multiplier severity R=96.11784 implies residual R2 above .989596, but this is not a population estimate because the development row and champion aggregate are unmatched. The 59.276B closure exceeds the conditional <=1.0404% overhead needed for an oracle sampler/anchor blend. Kill constant/approximate-anchor residualization; preserve angular/radial/q3/FP32 components for a new exact-mean coupled observable.

candidates.bias_class: Goal-oriented higher-cumulant correction with exact base moments and compressed signed residual transport.
candidates.kill_condition: Probe values require dense/sample-expensive unknown cumulants; coefficient system remains ill-conditioned or unidentifiable; combined fidelity/signs fall below 80%; added cost reaches 80B; or any estimator uses oracle targets for formation.
candidates.mechanism: Compress only the signed design-relevant k3/k4 correction into the screened <=12-dimensional covariance-generated algebra and rank-four contraction factors, forming coefficients matrix-free with symmetry-paired orthogonal probes.
candidates.prediction: Orthogonal probes identify the screened algebra stably from weight/current-state observables, preserve at least 80% contraction fidelity and signs, and fit inside the analytic 80B envelope without dense tensors.
candidates.result: Oracle-fed 128-line inverses preserve the contraction geometry (iid combined/correction .926273/.983525, orthogonal .924790/.983457, both94/94 signs), but constant-modulus probes are exactly blind to the trace-free diagonal algebra coordinate. Minimum identifiable k3/k4 fractions are .3611/.2051, nullities reach47/62, and antipodal pairing adds zero rank. More decisively, the preserved second-order state supplies the inverse design but no directional k3/k4 right-hand side. Free responses would cost only12.340B total; sampled responses cap at10719 paths or about670/cell under80B with ideal skew/kurtosis SE .095/.189. Kill this coefficient-formation link; preserve the <=12D representation and reopen only with nonconstant-amplitude probes plus a weights-only Price/Hermite higher-moment response recurrence.

candidates.bias_class: Exact structural arithmetic; r_V identically 1, so the promotion gate reduces to r_C < 1 and needs no statistical oracle.
candidates.kill_condition: p(l) >= 0.5 at every interior depth, or achievable r_C >= 0.95 under the champion's own 126-frame antipodal direction geometry, or no cheap certificate exists that establishes the classification without spending the arithmetic the fold avoids.
candidates.mechanism: Extend the champion's exact dead/always-on/kink neuron folding beyond its hard-coded final three layers to every layer whose kink fraction admits it, re-associating the arithmetic without altering any predicted value.
candidates.prediction: The kink fraction p(l) falls with depth as activations concentrate, dropping below the 0.5 break-even for the last 8 or more layers and yielding a materially sub-1 cost ratio on top of the deployed fold3.
candidates.result: Killed by direct measurement on fresh synthetic He n256/L32 networks under the champion's exact geometry (126 Haar frames x 256 columns x antipodes = 64,512 directions). The window algebra gives per-window cost 256 + 2*sum|KINK_l| against a baseline 256k, so an interior layer is profitable exactly when p_l < 0.5 and r_C = 1 - (1/L)*sum_{p_l<0.5}(1-2p_l). Measured p(l) falls monotonically with depth but plateaus at 0.48-0.56 from layer 27 onward, never clearing the threshold: only 6/31 interior layers qualify and empirical r_C is 0.9780 -- and that figure is a ceiling that assumes exact classification is free. The Cauchy-Schwarz certificate z_i >= w_i.h_ref - ||w_i||R is far too loose to certify a single neuron, giving deployable r_C = 1.0000. Reducing the direction count improves foldability only weakly (32 frames 0.9664; 8 frames 0.9507; 2 frames 0.9263), and the multiplier floor caps that reduction at 7.4x, so the sample-count/foldability interaction cannot rescue it either. Kill fold-depth extension. Preserve the gate-census diagnostic and the window cost algebra; record the constraint that exact gate folding is sample-count-limited -- p rises with the direction count, which is why fold3 stops at three layers and why no deeper fold was available to the campaign. Independent closed-form corroboration: iterating the ReLU arc-cosine correlation map c_{l+1}=(sqrt(1-c^2)+c(pi-arccos c))/pi predicts kink fraction >= 0.514 at every layer with the minimum at l=32, agreeing with the measurement. Note also that the window model above omits kink-to-kink coupling inside a window, whose true condition is strictly tighter than p_l < 0.5; the kill is therefore conservative.
